Not that people can't abuse LDN capsules...

parent: Low-dose naltrexone (LDN) - how's it working for you? Helsbells asked if there was a poll on how LDN is working for people.  I couldn't find one so I thought I'd make one...
text: About the time I started taking LDN, I developed an upset stomach.  It's common for me to have an upset stomach for 4-6 weeks at a time, at least since I came down with CFIDS 27 years ago, but this one dragged on and after 3 months I decided it had to be caused by the LDN.  I stopped taking the LDN and the upset stomach went away within days.  It's been about two months now and I'll probably try the LDN again...I didn't get any obvious benefits during the time that I was taking it but I want to give it another chance.
